title: Lithic services panel
description: A tall black panel with 24px corners: a two-line headline, a bold white lead and a grey paragraph on the left, a device render bleeding off the top-right corner, then a centred headline over glassy white/10 cards (two wide with gold arrow links, three narrow) that brighten on hover and rise into view as you scroll. Gold contour rings drift behind. Centred and stacked on phones.
notes: the panel always reads the theme's .dark colours (black, white ink, highlight = gold)
cards fade and rise 24px on entering view (CSS scroll-driven; static where unsupported or with reduced motion)
the render is a media slot (736×524); empty, a dim rounded placeholder
on a page whose own background is black (dark mode), the panel has no visible edge
